title: Legacy Documentation - MongoDB Documentation - MongoDB Docs
content:
Legacy Documentation

MongoDB recommends that you upgrade products to the most recent version so that you can use the most up-to-date documentation. MongoDB documents supported product versions through MongoDB Documentation.

If you cannot upgrade to a supported version, MongoDB provides legacy documentation for versions that have reached their end-of-life and are no longer recommended for use. MongoDB does not maintain or update legacy documentation.
